en: Black-and-white interior view of a large, bright lounge or dining room with polished wooden floors, wicker armchairs and tables covered with tablecloths. Large windows line the far wall, letting in natural light. Some framed pictures hang on the walls. Text at the bottom left identifies the location as Uddevalla, Bohusgården, and a printer or photographer credit appears in the lower right corner.
